title: 高市首相 オーストラリアへ出発 あす日豪首脳会談

translated_text: The Prime Minister has concluded the schedule in Vietnam and departed for the next visiting country, Australia. On the 4th, they will hold talks with Prime Minister Albanese and aim to produce a joint statement regarding the smooth supply of LNG (liquefied natural gas) and other energy resources.
title_en: Prime Minister Departs for Australia - Japan-Australia Summit Talks Tomorrow
